title: Cheapest sony wh-1000xm5 today
overview: The Sony flagship wireless headphones are on sale for $328 at Amazon today, down from the usual $399 list price. [1] Best Buy lists the Sony flagship wireless headphones at $349 with in-store pickup available in most regions. [2] Walmart offers the Sony flagship wireless headphones for $335 through a third party seller with standard shipping. [3]

key_findings.text: The Sony flagship wireless headphones are on sale for $328 at Amazon today, down from the usual $399 list price.
Best Buy lists the Sony flagship wireless headphones at $349 with in-store pickup available in most regions.
Walmart offers the Sony flagship wireless headphones for $335 through a third party seller with standard shipping.
Price trackers say the noise cancelling flagship rarely drops below $350 in any season.
The retailer says the noise cancelling model remains its best selling headphone this quarter.
Buyers should note the third party listing has a longer return window than direct sales.
